caption: Samaltak · Debugger and Profiler. Every click and keystroke here is sent remotely through samaltak-ctl.
spoken: [warm] Hey! So this is Samaltak's debugger and profiler. And here's the fun part: nobody's touching the mouse. Every click and every keystroke you'll see comes in remotely, through samaltak control.

caption: Breakpoints live in the image: pick Integer>>gcd: in the System Browser and click the dot next to it.
spoken: Let's start with a breakpoint. Breakpoints just live in the image. So: Integer, gcd, and [pause] click that little dot next to the method.

caption: Start the Mandelbrot rendering in its own Process, then print 48 gcd: 18 in the Workspace (⌘P).
spoken: Now let's kick off the Mandelbrot. It renders in its own process. And over in the workspace, we print forty-eight gcd eighteen.

caption: The breakpoint hits. The Debugger is its own Process: the Workspace is suspended, the Mandelbrot keeps rendering.
spoken: [excited] And there's our breakpoint! The debugger gets its own process, too. See? The workspace is suspended, but the Mandelbrot just keeps on rendering.

caption: Step Over: the highlighted statement moves through gcd:, and the temps update live.
spoken: Let's step over a few times. Watch the highlight move through the method, and the temps update right along with it.

caption: Evaluate in the stopped frame: a + b, printed with ⌘P.
spoken: You can even evaluate right inside the stopped frame. a plus b, and [pause] there's the answer.

caption: Proceed: the computation finishes and the Workspace prints the result.
spoken: Okay, proceed. The computation finishes, and the workspace prints the result.

caption: A message nobody implements: 3 zork. The notifier offers to Create the method.
spoken: Now let's send a message nobody implements. Three zork. [pause] Yep, the notifier's offering to just create it.

caption: Write the method right in the Debugger, accept with ⌘S, then Proceed: the original send is retried.
spoken: So we write the method right there in the debugger, accept it, hit proceed, and the original send goes through. Three hundred.

caption: Watchpoints reuse the immutability bit: inspect p := 3 @ 4, right-click x, choose Halt on write.
spoken: Watchpoints are pretty neat: they reuse the immutability bit. Inspect a point, right-click x, and pick halt on write.

caption: A forked Process moves p. The store into x is refused, and the Debugger opens on the writing statement.
spoken: Now a forked process tries to move that point. The store into x gets refused, and we land in the debugger, right on the line that wrote it.

caption: Unwatch and Proceed: the store is retried and the mover runs to completion.
spoken: Unwatch, proceed, and the store goes through. The process finishes up.

caption: The Profiler is always on: a 1 MB ring of stack samples. Fork a long computation, render the Mandelbrot, open the Profiler.
spoken: Alright, the profiler. It's always on, keeping a one-megabyte ring of stack samples. Let's give it something to chew on: a long computation, a busy Mandelbrot, and then we open the profiler.

caption: Flame graph of every Process. Click a frame to zoom into it.
spoken: Here's the flame graph for every process. Click a frame to zoom in.

caption: Filter by Process: one click profiles just the Mandelbrot window.
spoken: Want just one window? One click, and it only shows the Mandelbrot.

caption: Tally: the classic Smalltalk MessageTally tree, from the same samples.
spoken: This is the tally view: good old Smalltalk message tally, from the same samples.

caption: Allocations are sampled on the bump allocator’s limit check, so the fast path is unchanged.
spoken: Allocations get sampled too. It piggybacks on the allocator's limit check, so the fast path doesn't change at all.

caption: Frame timeline: per frame, which Processes ran, plus draw, raster, GPU and GC. Drag to select a range.
spoken: And here's the frame timeline. For every frame, you see which processes ran, and how long drawing, rasterizing, the GPU, and GC took. Let's drag out a range.

caption: The selected range now filters the flame graph.
spoken: And now the flame graph only shows that range.

caption: Debugger, Profiler, every window: all driven remotely through samaltak-ctl.
spoken: [warm] So, that's it. Debugger, profiler, every single window, all driven remotely. Thanks for watching!
